description_en: Registers a device under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口在指定产品下注册设备
name: RegisterDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device to be registered belongs. ProductKey is the product key issued by IoT Platform when you create a product and serves as the globally unique identifier of the product.
You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh:
待注册设备所隶属的产品的ProductKey。ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的产品Key，作为其全局唯一标识符。
您可以在物联网平台控制台查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device to be registered. The device name must be 4 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:).

DeviceName is typically used in combination with ProductKey as the device identifier.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly generates a device name
parameters.help_zh:
为待注册的设备命名。设备名称长度为4~32个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、半角句号（.）、半角冒号（:）。

DeviceName通常与ProductKey组合使用，用作设备标识。

如果不传入该参数，则由系统随机生成设备名称
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The DevEUI of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device
parameters.help_zh:
LoRaWAN设备的DevEUI。

创建LoRaWAN设备时，该参数必传
parameters.name: dev_eui

parameters.help_en:
The alias of the device to be registered. The alias must be 4 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system does not generate an alias for the device
parameters.help_zh:
为待注册的设备设置备注名称。备注名称长度为4~64个字符，可包含中文汉字、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文汉字算2个字符。

如果不传入该参数，系统不会为设备生成备注名称
parameters.name: nickname

parameters.help_en:
The PIN Code of the LoRa device, which is used to verify the validity of the DevEUI.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and LoraNodeType is set to ALIYUNDEFINED
parameters.help_zh:
LoRaWAN设备的PIN Code，用于校验DevEUI的合法性。

创建LoRaWAN设备时，LoraNodeType为ALIYUNDEFINED，该参数必传
parameters.name: pin_code

parameters.help_en:
The JoinEui of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and LoraNodeType is set to USERDEFINED
parameters.help_zh:
LoRaWAN设备的入网凭证JoinEui。

创建LoRaWAN设备时，LoraNodeType为USERDEFINED，该参数必传
parameters.name: join_eui

parameters.help_en:
The AppKey of the LoRa device.

This parameter is required when you create a LoRa device and LoraNodeType is set to USERDEFINED
parameters.help_zh:
LoRaWAN设备的AppKey。

创建LoRaWAN设备时，LoraNodeType为USERDEFINED，该参数必传
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The type of the LoRa device. Valid values:

ALIYUNDEFINED: Alibaba Cloud-issued type. You must also specify DevEui and PinCode.
USERDEFINED: User-defined type. You must also specify DevEui, JoinEui, and AppKey
parameters.help_zh:
LoRaWAN设备类型。可取值：

ALIYUNDEFINED：阿里云颁发类型，需同时传入DevEui和PinCode。
USERDEFINED：用户自定义类型，需同时传入DevEui、JoinEui和AppKey
parameters.name: lora_node_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device information returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回注册的设备信息

DevEui.description_en: The DevEUI of the LoRa device. This parameter is returned only for LoRa devices
DevEui.description_zh: LoRaWAN设备的DevEUI。仅LoRaWAN设备才会返回该参数

DeviceName.description_en:
The device name.

<notice> Keep this information confidential.
</notice>
DeviceName.description_zh:
设备名称。

<notice> 请妥善保管，勿泄露。
</notice>

DeviceSecret.description_en:
The device secret.

<notice> Keep this information confidential.
</notice>
DeviceSecret.description_zh:
设备密钥。

<notice> 请妥善保管，勿泄露。
</notice>

IotId.description_en:
The device ID issued by IoT Platform, which serves as the unique identifier of the device.

<notice> Keep this information confidential.
</notice>
IotId.description_zh:
物联网平台为该设备颁发的设备ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符。

<notice> 请妥善保管，勿泄露。
</notice>

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI of the LoRa device. This parameter is returned only for LoRa devices
JoinEui.description_zh: LoRaWAN设备的入网凭证 JoinEUI。仅LoRaWAN设备才会返回该参数

Nickname.description_en:
The alias of the device.
If you did not set an alias for the device, this parameter is empty
Nickname.description_zh:
设备的备注名称。
若您没有为该设备设置备注名称，则该参数返回为空

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
